title: The Truth About Lying on Your Resume
description:
Most people treat their resume like a confession.
Employers treat it like a marketing brochure.

We act like lying on a resume is a mortal sin.
Meanwhile companies need “5 years of experience” in a software built last Tuesday.

So, I wanted to unpack the places people actually lie, why recruiters rarely notice, and the weird ethics behind all of it.

Uploaded from my room in NYC. Nothing too exciting.

00:00 - My Case for bending morality
